t: This is London Contemporary Dance School, a school for training contemporary dancers. It was founded in 1966 by Robin Howard, a British philanthropist and dance patron who did a great deal to promote modern dance in the UK. He started the school to train new dancers for his own company, London Contemporary Dance Theatre. He is also remembered as the founder of The Place. For many years the school was part of the Conservatoire for Dance and Drama. Since 2022 it has been independently registered with the Office for Students.
